check_vasp_electronic_convergence: check if a VASP DFT calculation converged electronically by parsing the OSZICAR file in a given path
count_scf_and_ionic_steps: count the total SCF and ionic steps from VASP OSZICAR output files in a DFT calculation directory
review_converged_oszicar_function: review the converged_oszicar function that checks electronic convergence using NELM and EDIFF thresholds
refactor_converged_oszicar_for_other_dft: refactor the converged_oszicar function to support DFT tools beyond VASP by replacing the Oszicar parser
test_count_scf_function: test the count_scf function to verify it correctly tallies SCF and ionic steps from OSZICAR files
